extraction.name: arabic-img2md and arabic-books
extraction.description: arabic-img2md is a synthetic dataset of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. arabic-books is a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML scraped from the Hindawi website
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Scraped HTML content was converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to create paired image-Markdown samples for training.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Contributes to the broader field of document parsing and promotes the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset is derived from Hindawi's web content and may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Models trained on the data may exhibit hallucination and repetition. The dataset may not generalize to diverse genres and styles. The models may struggle with cross-script generalization and complex layouts containing dense tables, charts, or images.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, evaluation, and downstream NLP tasks for Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction.
